coordinatorConsole.title: Conversations
coordinatorConsole.intro: People you're talking with about working together. Each row shows who acts next and by when.
coordinatorConsole.empty: No conversations are assigned to you right now.
coordinatorConsole.recoveryOnly: You can reassign conversations that have no available owner. You can't read their notes.
coordinatorConsole.timezoneHelp: Dates and times you enter are in {timezone}.

queue.caption: Conversations, with the ones that need us first
queue.sortNote: Sorted with the replies we owe that are past their date first, then conversations with no owner, then the other replies we owe, then the rest.

flag.ownerlessHelp: {name}'s conversation has no one looking after it. Reassign it so they have a named contact.
flag.auditPending: A record of a change hasn't been delivered yet. Saved changes remain in effect.
flag.closingSaved: Closing message saved on {date}. No notice has been sent.
flag.noticeSaved: A notice for {name} was saved on {date}. No notice has been sent.
flag.unconfirmed: A request for this conversation isn't confirmed yet. Confirm it before you make another change.

alert.recording: The recording service was last unavailable on {date}. A request can be refused when its record can't be saved. Only a saved result confirms that Stop or revoke took effect. A saved change can still be waiting for its record to be delivered. If the outcome is unknown, check it or retry the same request.
alert.identity: The sign-in service was last unavailable on {date}. While it is down, people may not be able to open their conversations, and preparing a new one is refused.
alert.lastSeen: This shows the last time a problem was seen. It doesn't say the problem is still there.

prepare.title: Prepare a conversation
prepare.intro: This creates the conversation. It doesn't create an invitation, send anything or give the person access to anything.
prepare.nameHelp: Shown in your queue. If we already keep a name for this person, we keep that one and not this one.
prepare.contactHelp: We check this against our contact rules before anything is prepared.
prepare.ownerContactHelp: Shown to the person so they can contact you directly.
prepare.nextSummaryHelp: In plain words, what happens next.
prepare.languageNote: Invitations are in English for now.
prepare.receipt: Set up. {name}'s conversation exists, with no invitation yet. Nothing has been sent.
prepare.receiptGeneric: Set up. The conversation exists, with no invitation yet. Nothing has been sent. The name shown in your queue may differ from the one you entered.
prepare.ownerNote: You will be the owner of this conversation, and the person will see your contact details. To give it to someone else, use Reassign owner afterwards.
prepare.emailHelp: We check our contact rules, then look for the person's sign-in. Nothing is created yet.
prepare.needsConfirm: Find and confirm a sign-in before you set up the conversation.
prepare.selectionLapsed: The sign-in you confirmed has expired or changed, so this request wasn't applied. Find the sign-in again and confirm it.

lookup.title: Find the person's sign-in
lookup.help: We check our contact rules first, then look for one sign-in that matches this email exactly. Nothing is created and nothing is sent.
lookup.foundIntro: Check that the name and email are the person you mean. If this is someone else, choose Not this one.
lookup.consequence: The invitation will only work for this sign-in.
lookup.confirmed: Confirmed. Nothing has been created yet. You can set up the conversation now.
lookup.rejected: Not used. Change the email or find the sign-in again.
lookup.cleared: The email changed, so the confirmed sign-in was cleared. Find the sign-in again.
lookup.none: We couldn't find exactly one sign-in for this email, so nothing was chosen. Check the spelling. A conversation can only be prepared for a person who already has a sign-in.
lookup.unavailable: The sign-in service couldn't answer, so nothing was chosen. Your entries are kept. Try again in a few minutes.

invitation.previewIntro: This is a preview of the invitation {name} would get. No invitation exists yet, and nothing is sent.
invitation.issueReceipt: Invitation saved for {name}. It is open until {date}. Nothing has been sent.
invitation.resendBody: The earlier invitation will stop working.
invitation.resendReceipt: New invitation saved for {name}. The earlier one no longer works. Nothing has been sent.
invitation.revokeBody: {name} will see the same page as for an expired invitation. This takes effect at once and can't be undone.
invitation.revokeReceipt: Revoked. {name} can no longer use this invitation.
invitation.validityPolicy: Invitations stay open for the period set in the conversation settings. You can't change it here.
invitation.linkOnce: This link is shown once. Only {name}'s sign-in can use it.
invitation.linkUnavailable: This invitation's link can't be shown again. Resend to make a new one. The earlier link stops working.

nextStep.title: Set next step
nextStep.pausedNote: While this conversation is paused, only the owner can be changed.
nextStep.movedForwardNote: Only steps for {agencyName} can be set here.
nextStep.receipt: Saved. {name} will see this next step.

pause.title: Pause this conversation
pause.intro: {name} will be told that {agencyName} paused it, and that {ownerName} will update them by the date you set.
pause.receipt: Paused. You owe {name} an update by {date}.

resume.title: Resume this conversation?
resume.body: {name} will see it as active again, and a reply will be owed to them.
resume.receipt: Resumed. You owe {name} a reply by {date}.

close.title: Close this conversation
close.intro: {name} will read your reason and your message. Delivering that message is on you until it has reached them.
close.messageHelp: Say it kindly and plainly. It is shown exactly as written.
close.contactHelp: A route for a second look.
close.confirmBody: {name} will no longer be able to reply. They can read your message for a limited time. This can't be undone.
close.receipt: Closed. Your message to {name} is saved. No notice has been sent, so tell {name} yourself.

reassign.title: Reassign owner
reassign.contactLabel: How {name} can reach the new owner
reassign.help: {name} will see the change the next time they open the conversation. No message is sent.

proposal.title: Propose moving forward
proposal.intro: {name} chooses. Nothing changes unless they agree, and they can decline or keep talking.
proposal.receipt: Proposal saved. It takes effect only if {name} agrees. They have until {date} to answer.

note.told: {name} was told that only the person looking after their conversation can read this.

receipt.recordNotDelivered: Saved. The record of this change hasn't been delivered yet.

errors.invalid: Some details are missing or not valid, so this request wasn't applied. Your entries are kept. Check each field and save again.
errors.conflict: This conversation changed while you were working, so this request wasn't applied. Your entries are kept. Review the current state, then save again.
errors.notFound: That conversation isn't available to you, or it has changed since you opened it. This request wasn't applied.
errors.contactRefusedWithReason: We can't contact this person, so this request wasn't applied. {reasonMessage}
errors.contactRefused: We can't contact this person, so this request wasn't applied. No reason is available to show here.
errors.identityNotFound: We couldn't find an active sign-in for this person, so this request wasn't applied. Check the details you entered.
errors.identityUnavailable: The sign-in service isn't responding, so this request wasn't applied. Try again in a few minutes. Your entries are kept.
errors.recordingUnavailable: The recording service isn't available, so this request wasn't applied. Try again shortly. Your entries are kept.
errors.policyUnavailable: Something needed to run conversations isn't set up yet, so this request wasn't applied. Ask the site owner to complete the conversation settings on the status report.
errors.invitationLinkUnavailable: Invitation links can't be made yet, so this request wasn't applied. The site owner needs to configure invitation links.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests just now, so this request wasn't applied. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.uncertain: We couldn't confirm whether this was saved. Open the conversation to see where it stands before you do anything else. If you try again from this page, the same request is never applied twice.
errors.closeIncomplete: Choose a reason, write a message and add a contact route. All three are needed.
errors.checkFirst: If you tried this before and weren't sure it saved, open the queue to check before you try again.
errors.uncertainInvitation: We couldn't confirm whether the new invitation was saved, and its link wasn't shown. To get a link you can use, choose Resend invitation again. It replaces any earlier link, so an earlier one stops working.
errors.uncertainIssue: We couldn't confirm whether the invitation was saved. Open the conversation to check. If it now offers Resend invitation instead of Save invitation, it was saved but you didn't see its link. Resend makes a new link, and the earlier one stops working.

recovery.title: Check where this stands
recovery.unconfirmedHeading: We don't know yet whether this was saved
recovery.unconfirmedBody: Until we know, don't make another change to {name}'s conversation. Try the same request again, or open the conversation to look.
recovery.prepareUnconfirmedBody: We don't know yet whether {name}'s conversation was set up. Try the same request again, or look for {name} in the queue.
recovery.retryExactHelp: This repeats your request exactly. If it was already saved, you get its receipt and nothing is applied twice. If it wasn't saved and the conversation hasn't changed, it is applied now. If the conversation has changed, nothing is applied and you see what changed.
recovery.prepareRetryHelp: This repeats your request exactly. If it was already saved, you get its receipt and nothing is applied twice. If it wasn't saved, it is applied now, as long as the sign-in you confirmed is still valid.
recovery.stillUnconfirmed: We still can't confirm whether this was saved. Don't make another change yet. Try again in a few minutes.
recovery.accessLost: We still can't confirm whether this was saved, and you can no longer open this conversation. Ask the person who looks after it now to check it.
recovery.blocked: Confirm the earlier request first. Other changes to this conversation wait until then.
recovery.invitationNoLink: If this invitation was saved, its receipt doesn't include the link. Choose Resend invitation to get a link you can use.
recovery.changedBody: This request wasn't saved because {name}'s conversation changed first. Your entries are kept on this page.
recovery.reviewHelp: Shows the conversation as it is now, next to what you entered. Nothing is applied until you choose.
recovery.entriesKept: Your entries are kept on this page. Copy anything you need before you leave it.
recovery.applyButton: Apply my changes as a new request
recovery.applyHelp: This is a new request, not a retry. It acts on the conversation as it is now, so check what it says now first.
recovery.discardHelp: This clears what you entered. It can't be undone.
recovery.unavailable: {name}'s conversation is now {state}, so this can't be applied. Your entries are kept on this page so you can copy them.
recovery.unavailableGeneric: This review can't be applied here because access to the conversation is no longer available. It won't be applied later on its own, and what you entered isn't shown on this page. If you still need to make this change, ask someone who can open the conversation.
recovery.ackHelp: This only lets you make other changes to this conversation from this session. It doesn't change the conversation.
recovery.ackNotSavedNote: Acknowledging doesn't apply what you entered. To make those changes, choose Review what changed.
recovery.returnPending: Go back to the unconfirmed request
recovery.returnResult: See the result of the earlier request
recovery.guardScope: This hold applies to this session only. Someone else, or another sign-in of yours, can still change this conversation.
recovery.expiredHeading: We can no longer try this request again
recovery.expiredBody: Your session ended or the saved copy of this request expired, so it can't be tried again, and we won't send it again for you. Open {name}'s conversation and check what happened before you make a change.
recovery.expiredBodyGeneric: The saved copy of this request is no longer available, so it can't be tried again, and we won't send it again for you. Check what happened before you make another change.
recovery.expiredEntries: Anything you typed may not have been kept. Don't count on it.
recovery.expiredCheck: If you still can't tell whether it was saved, ask the site owner to check the record of changes.
recovery.expiredContinueHelp: This lets you make other changes. It doesn't tell us whether the earlier request was saved.
recovery.capacityHeading: We can't take another request right now
recovery.capacityBody: This request wasn't applied. This session is already keeping as many earlier requests as it can. Nothing is removed to make room, and waiting may not free any.
recovery.capacityStepsIntro: To make room, work through the earlier requests that apply:
recovery.capacityAck: A saved or not-saved result stays until you acknowledge it. Acknowledge the ones you've read.
recovery.capacityExpired: A request whose saved copy has expired stays until you've checked what happened and chosen to continue.
recovery.capacityUnknown: A request we can't confirm yet can't be dismissed. Open it and try the same request again.
recovery.capacityDraft: A request you haven't saved yet can be discarded if you no longer need it.
recovery.capacityReturn: See the earlier requests this session is keeping
recovery.heldHeading: Earlier requests this session is keeping
recovery.heldEmpty: This session isn't keeping any earlier requests.

review.buttonHelp: Shows exactly what will be saved. Nothing is saved until you confirm on the next step.
review.heading: Check this before you save
review.intro: This is what will be saved for {name}. Nothing has been saved yet.
review.basis: It is based on {name}'s conversation as it is now ({state}). If the conversation changes before you save, this request isn't applied and you see what changed.
review.commitNote: The button below saves this. It is the only step that changes anything.
review.expired: This review has expired, so this request wasn't applied. Your entries are kept. Review them again to continue.
